headline: Aurobindo Pharma USA Receives FTC Approval to Acquire Lannett Company
sum: Aurobindo Pharma's US subsidiary has received FTC antitrust clearance to acquire Lannett Company, a Pennsylvania-based generic pharmaceuticals manufacturer, marking a significant cross-border consolidation in the US generics space.
detail: Aurobindo Pharma USA, the US subsidiary of India-listed Aurobindo Pharma Limited, received FTC approval on or before 22 June 2026 to proceed with the acquisition of Lannett Company, Inc., a US-domiciled generic pharmaceuticals manufacturer based in Pennsylvania. Lannett is a mid-sized generic player with a portfolio of solid oral and injectable products. The FTC approval represents completion of US antitrust review under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act and resolves the principal regulatory hurdle for closing.
